Importer.title: Import from Google Sheet
Importer.menuHint: Download the Elaria Google Sheet and create or update the mastery and gear compendiums from it.
Importer.intro: Paste the link to the Elaria Google Sheet (or choose a downloaded .xlsx copy) and press Check. Every mastery tab and the Gear tab are converted, and you see what will change before anything is imported. Run it again whenever the sheet changes: changed entries are updated in place, new ones are added, and nothing is duplicated.
Importer.mergedNote: Masteries shared by several disciplines are stored once and list all their disciplines ({n} duplicate copies merged).
Importer.keptSeparate: {n} shared masteries differ between disciplines and are kept as separate entries
Importer.removeMissing: Remove imported entries that are no longer in the sheet (hand-made entries are never removed)
Importer.confirm: Add {created} new entries, update {changed}, and remove {removed}?
Importer.doneNotice: Elaria data imported: {created} added, {updated} updated, {removed} removed.
Importer.linkHint: The sheet must be shared as “Anyone with the link → Viewer”. Only a copy is downloaded; nothing is ever written to the sheet.
Importer.badLinkInline: That doesn't look like a Google Sheets link (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/…).
Importer.sheetWarnings: {n} things to check in the sheet
Importer.sheetWarningsHint: Nothing here stops the import. These are cells the converter had to guess about or links it couldn't make; most are typos or renamed masteries or gear.
Importer.unknownTags: {n} tags not on the Tags tab
Importer.savedTo: The converted data was saved to {path}.

error.badLink: That doesn't look like a Google Sheets link. Copy the address from the sheet's browser tab (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/…).
error.notShared: Google wouldn't hand out a copy of the sheet ({detail}). Open the sheet → Share → General access → “Anyone with the link”, role Viewer, then press Check again.
error.network: Couldn't reach Google ({detail}). Check the internet connection of the computer running this browser.
error.http: Google answered with an error (HTTP {detail}). Try again in a minute.

Importer.noLink: Paste the link to your Google Sheet, or choose a downloaded .xlsx file, first.

Importer.configOff: {file} turns off: {list}. Those compendiums are left as they are.
Importer.orFile: No link? Use a downloaded copy (File → Download → Microsoft Excel .xlsx):

Importer.fileFromFoundry: from Foundry's files: Check reads this file instead of the link
Importer.clearFile: Stop using this file and go back to the link
Importer.pickXlsx: Pick an .xlsx file (Google Sheets: File → Download → Microsoft Excel).
Importer.notXlsx: {name} isn't an .xlsx file. In Google Sheets use File → Download → Microsoft Excel (.xlsx).
Importer.backgroundsFound: Backgrounds found: {n} scales. They'll be saved for the Background section of character sheets.

Bestiary.intro: Paste the link to the Bestiary sheet (or choose a downloaded .xlsx) and press Check. Every tab is searched for monster stat blocks (Name, Type: …, Power: …, stats, abilities table), so new tabs and monsters are found by themselves. Monsters become actors in the Bestiary folder, one sub-folder per power. Run it again whenever the sheet changes: imported monsters are updated in place (their picture and token settings are kept); monsters you made yourself are never touched.

Bestiary.needSource: Paste the Bestiary sheet's link, or choose an .xlsx file.

Turn.settingHint: Initiative rolls are action windows for each side: anyone on that side who hasn't acted this round can act in one, picked by the side's last actor. Turn off for Foundry's normal one-turn-per-roll initiative.
Turn.buttonHint: Turn panel: who's acting, end your turn or delay, and pick who acts in your side's next window
Turn.delayHint: Move this window later in the turn order (for good) and act in it when it comes up this round
Turn.delayIntro: Your side's window moves to just after the window you choose, and stays there in later rounds. You act in it when it comes up this round.
Turn.delayNext: Who acts in the party window opening now?
Turn.noLater: There's no later window to delay to this round.
Turn.delayed: {name} delays: the {side} window moves to after the window at {init}.
Turn.actNowHint: GM: someone else on this side acts in the current window (the one acting now hasn't acted after all)
Turn.youPick: You pick who acts in this window:
Turn.noPick: If nobody is picked, whoever sits in the window acts (or the first who hasn't acted).
Turn.nobodyLeft: Nobody left to act this round.
Turn.toggleActedHint: GM: click to mark as acted / not acted this round
Turn.restoreHint: Undo: bring this window back where it is, without a new roll (also clears Defeated; it stays even at 0 HP until they're back up)
Turn.windowRestored: {name}'s window at {init} is back in the turn order.
Turn.off: Action windows are turned off (game settings), so initiative works as usual.
Turn.rollFirst: Roll initiative first: every roll is an action window for its side.
Turn.nobody: Nobody can act in any window: check initiative and who is defeated.
Turn.needsGM: A GM has to be connected for that.
Turn.skipped: The {side} window ({init}) is skipped: nobody on that side is left to act.
Turn.windowRemoved: {name} is out of the fight: their side's window at {init} is removed.
Turn.removeIntro: {name} is KO'd or defeated, so one of the {side}'s windows is removed. Which one? (It goes when the current turn ends.)
